chunks.title: About Me
chunks.content: About Me Applied AI Engineer for AI Automation, AI/ML, and LLM product roles. Reliable AI automation. Product-minded engineering. Computer vision depth. I build applied AI systems that take research into usable products and workflows. My focus is computer vision, real-time inference, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM-enabled automation backed by APIs and practical reliability controls. My flagship work is Shifaa, a privacy-first patient-monitoring platform. I worked on its real-time seizure-detection pipeline using Vision Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python. I hold a dual degree in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence from Ain Shams University and the University of East London (Class of 2026, GPA: 3.3/4.0). At Cultiv Bureau, I apply the same mindset to AI automation: n8n workflows, RAG, CRM integrations, APIs, webhooks, and production debugging. Computer Vision Healthcare AI RAG AI Automation Real-Time Inference

chunks.title: Professional Context: CohereVoice Studio - Speech AI And Meeting Intelligence
chunks.content: CohereVoice Studio - Speech AI And Meeting Intelligence Dates: August 2026 - September 2026 Repository: <https://github.com/omarsalama4/coherevoice-studio - End-to-end speech AI platform for Egyptian Arabic and multilingual audio. - Integrates CohereLabs Transcribe, Whisper/wav2vec-based alignment, and pyannote speaker diarization. - Includes an LLM-powered meeting-minutes engine supporting OpenAI, Gemini, and Groq to generate executive summaries, topics, decisions, and action items. - Produces bilingual SRT/WebVTT subtitles with reading-speed and line-length constraints. - Provides a Streamlit UI and CLI batch-processing workflows with GPU acceleration and automated tests. Stack: Python , PyTorch , CUDA , Streamlit , ASR , Whisper , wav2vec 2.0 , pyannote.audio , OpenAI , Gemini , Groq , FFmpeg . Attribution boundary: The repository credits bakrianoo/cohereX as an original foundation. Describe Omar's work as integrating, extending, adapting, or productizing the available implementation where applicable; do not imply authorship of third-party base models or libraries. Technical workflow 1. Accept audio or video through the Streamlit UI or command-line interface. 2. Extract and normalize audio with FFmpeg. 3. Route Arabic and multilingual media to the appropriate ASR model. 4. Generate transcription, speaker diarization, word alignment, and time-coded segments. 5. Apply subtitle-splitting rules for readable SRT/WebVTT output, including line-length and reading-speed constraints. 6. Optionally generate translated or bilingual subtitle tracks. 7. Generate structured meeting minutes, including an executive overview, highlights, speaker-aware discussion records, topics, decisions, and action items. Public-safe achievement statement Built and extended a speech-AI studio that turns multilingual media into aligned transcripts, bilingual subtitles, speaker-aware meeting records, and structured summaries through a Streamlit UI and CLI workflow.

Important boundary: This is product and architecture work. Do not describe it as a launched or production-deployed multi-agent platform unless a public, verified deployment is available. Architecture context - Agent layer: role-specific AI employees, tool calling, RAG, capability boundaries, stop conditions, and approval gates. - Application layer: API services considered in NestJS and FastAPI, with business-system adapters for Bitrix24, Odoo, and n8n. - State and workflow layer: PostgreSQL, Redis, and Temporal considered for durable state, queues, and long-running workflows. - Observability layer: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana considered for tracing, monitoring, and operational visibility. - Safety layer: permissions, approvals, structured outputs, and auditability were included in the architecture scope. Safe phrasing Defined a multi-agent enterprise-AI architecture with tool access, permissions, approvals, stop conditions, and observability requirements for CRM and ERP workflows.

chunks.title: Professional Context: Shifaa - Privacy-First Hospital Clinical Decision Support
chunks.content: Shifaa - Privacy-First Hospital Clinical Decision Support Dates: October 2025 - July 2026 Context: Graduation project, Ain Shams University. Repository: <https://github.com/omarelnokrashy/Shifaa-AI-Based-Patient-Monitoring-System/tree/Windows-Deployment - Privacy-first, on-premises patient-monitoring platform combining a grounded medical assistant with cardiac-arrhythmia, fall-detection, and seizure-detection systems. - Personal contribution: engineered the hybrid real-time seizure-detection pipeline using Vision Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, OpenPose, ONNX Runtime, C++, and Python. - Reported seizure-pipeline results: 96.69% AUROC, 90.18% F1-score, and 37+ FPS, with pre-clinical seizure alerts. Boundary: Describe Shifaa as an academic project with reported metrics. Do not claim clinical validation, hospital readiness, or medical-device approval. Public repository architecture - Backend: FastAPI/Uvicorn gateway with REST, WebSocket, and server-sent-event interfaces; JWT and bcrypt authentication; endpoint-level RBAC; SQLAlchemy over SQLite or PostgreSQL. - Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, React Router, Axios, and Recharts; role-aware doctor, nurse, and admin views. - Inference services: independent arrhythmia, fall-detection, and seizure-detection services, each with dedicated code and documentation. - Seizure pipeline: C++/ONNX native runtime coordinated with a Python ViViT worker through Win32 named-pipe IPC; the public repository reports approximately 37.2 FPS steady-state throughput. - Fall pipeline: public repository describes YOLO, role classification, pose analysis, and CTR-GCN stages; repository-reported metrics are 91.59% accuracy, 94.87% F1, and 98.83% recall. - Arrhythmia pipeline: two-stage CNN-BiLSTM-Attention cascade with handcrafted QRS and heart-rate features; repository documents strict patient-level split isolation. - Grounded assistant: local-first LLM configuration, patient-record intent handling, and local deployment options using Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible provider. - Operations: alert lifecycle persists, broadcasts, acknowledges, and archives alerts to preserve an audit trail; deployment assets include Docker, systemd, and orchestration material. Individual-contribution boundary The public repository is a team graduation project. Omar's documented individual contribution is the hybrid real-time seizure-detection pipeline. Attribute other system components to the Shifaa team unless Omar's ownership is independently verified.

chunks.title: Professional Context: Liver Tumor AI - Detailed Evidence
chunks.content: Liver Tumor AI - Detailed Evidence Repository: <https://github.com/omarsalama4/liver-tumor-ai Live demo: <https://liver-tumor-ai-patient-independent.streamlit.app - Real-time tumor-presence classification and pixel-level segmentation for clinical CT/MRI slices. - Uses a patient-level train/validation split to prevent data leakage between patients. - Repository reports 95% classification accuracy on unseen patients and a 0.917 Dice segmentation score. - Includes explainable attention maps and a Streamlit deployment. - Public stack: PyTorch, segmentation-models-pytorch , and Streamlit. Safe project statement Developed a patient-independent liver-tumor detection and segmentation demo using PyTorch, with repository-reported 95% accuracy and 91.7% Dice. The evaluation emphasizes split hygiene to avoid patient leakage. Required caveat Do not reuse the repository phrase claiming hospital readiness. The public evidence demonstrates a research/demo system, not clinical validation.
